Hi Samantha / Finmo team,

Thanks again for the quick intake call last week. To speed the onboarding and get you ready for your internal auditors/procurement ask, can we run a condensed "mini-sprint" covering the SOC 2 scope, DPA review highlights, and a short pen-test scoping discussion? Our suggested format is a focused 90-minute session that includes:

- 25m: SOC 2 controls mapping + where we expect the most evidence requests
- 20m: DPA clauses & data flow walk-through (data residency / KMS notes)

- 15m: Action items and evidence handback plan

I've attached a slim agenda and an evidence index template to make the call productive. If 90 minutes feels long, we can compress to ~60–75m but would likely need to cut the DPA deep-dive or pen-test scoping.

- Thu Aug 20 — 10:00–11:30

Please let me know which slot works or if you prefer an alternate day/time. Also flag any internal stakeholders you want on the call (security lead, app owners, procurement).

Attachments: redwood-mini-sprint-agenda.pdf (agenda, goals, prep), evidence-index-redwood-v2.xlsx (template)

Thanks,
